genius.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-07. USDai is the non-yielding base token, backed 1:1 by PYUSD; sUSDai separately holds the loan-related exposure. The opened September 25 terms identify USD.AI Foundation as a Cayman Islands protocol operator and contracting entity, while the Foundation announcement calls it the DAO legal steward and says it does not operate the protocol. Neither document explicitly identifies the legal issuer of USDai. issuerEntity and issuerDomicile are therefore omitted; Foundation domicile is not treated as token-issuer domicile. Direct redemption delivers PYUSD or supported stablecoins, and the opened documents do not establish an issuer obligation to redeem for fixed national-currency monetary value. The October 1 product update restores permissionless direct 1:1 minting and redemption without whitelist or KYC; terms and technical documentation retain older institutional-access descriptions. redemptionPolicyPresent records that published token-redemption mechanism, not a legal right to fiat redemption. The reserve disclosure URL now describes base USDai and its PYUSD backing; the older proof-of-reserves guide covers protocol-wide reserves and infrastructure loans. The July 15 Proof of Loans AUP concerns GPU-loan attributes rather than monthly base-USDai reserve-to-liability assurance; no such monthly attestation was located in the consulted disclosures. The Foundation announcement attributes its GENIUS compliance claim to underlying PYUSD, not USDai. No token-specific public authorization, official application or registered foreign exception was found in the consulted regulatory and project materials. The unknown foreign posture and pre-effective DASP status do not assert that an exception exists or that other laws are inapplicable.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of the 2026-10-07 review, the consulted sources disclose no public GENIUS approval, state-qualified designation, officially pending GENIUS application or registered foreign exception naming USDai or its identified Foundation operator. The legal token issuer is not established, so the operator is not asserted to be the issuer. The OCC bank-licensing tracker is not a comprehensive GENIUS register; NYDFS licenses and general proposed rules are not token-specific GENIUS approvals. The issuer announcement makes its GENIUS claim about underlying PYUSD only. No matching public action was located in the scoped regulatory searches. This is a bounded negative review and does not exclude a confidential or unindexed filing.

applicabilityBasis.summary: USDai is marketed for payments and stable-value liquidity, but disclosed direct redemption returns PYUSD or other supported stablecoins. Section 2(22) requires an issuer obligation to convert, redeem or repurchase for fixed monetary value and expressly excludes a digital asset denominated in fixed monetary value as the redemption amount. The current public materials do not establish a fixed national-currency redemption obligation. Applicability remains genuinely ambiguous rather than a regulator-confirmed exclusion.
